properties.name: Balladoole
properties.description: Contour hillfort, enclosing important ritual sites spanning millennia. Mesolithic, neolithic and possibly Bronze age occupation. Iron age habitation and ramparts. Early Christian keeil and burials. Viking ship burial.

caveats: OSM community mapping, not the Manx National Heritage Historic Environment Record, which is the authoritative inventory and is not published as open data.
